lines.text: Find setups has 169 building blocks in 18 groups, from price and moving averages to structure, breakouts and company data.
Some groups show only when your administrator switches them on, and some are reached only through the Formula block under Advanced.
For example: moving averages such as SMA and EMA, oscillators such as RSI, market structure with swings and breaks, candle patterns, and RSI divergence.
In a row, tap the function's name to see the list, and search it.
The written guide lists every block with its settings.
Each block starts with a default setting. Change it to your own.
Information and education only, not investment advice.
Something not working? Start with the line beside Run: it names the reason.
When a stock could not be read, its row gives the reason and one button: Log in, Retry, or Try another timeframe.
Matched 0 of 50 does not mean something is broken. No stock met all the conditions on the last closed candle. Loosen, or switch off, the condition that removes the most.
Find setups missing, or showing Coming soon? It is not switched on for your organisation yet. Ask your administrator.
The broker's request limit was reached? Wait a minute, then press Retry.
Results differ from a live chart? The scan uses closed candles; a live chart also shows the forming one.
The time pill turned amber? The results are older than two candles of your timeframe. Press Run again for newer candles.
Information and education only, not investment advice.
That is Find setups: a list, a chart, a scan, a run, and the results.
Conditions on data, for your own study and your own decision.
A match is information, not a signal and not advice. Scans and alerts never place, change or cancel an order.
Keep the written guide beside you: it has every step, every block and every message.
Information and education only, not investment advice.
